title: Listen and choose 1.3
role: Tour operator solving a booking problem with a customer-service representative
can_do: I can describe a service problem that is still going on.
I can state what I need clearly and politely, and ask for a fee to be waived.

items.explanation: The speaker says: our payments have been rejected for three days.

items.prompt: What does the speaker want the OTA to do?

options.text: Confirm the restored booking in writing

items.explanation: The speaker wants the booking restored and confirmed in writing.

items.prompt: When might the fee be waived?

options.text: If they send a certificate by Friday

items.explanation: The fee might be waived if the certificate arrives before Friday.
